notes: Horizontal geographic coordinates restored from the former 0.06 layout to 1:1 meters; Goosebot and sensor ranges remain unscaled.
OSM/PDF-derived footprints and nominal building heights remain approximate, not a surveyed digital twin.
Home and delivery markers lie on mapped centerlines. Required goals A/B follow the crossing for a short full-map activity.
Water collision is a simulation abstraction; grass is excluded by the road-only planning mask.
FIPR Institute is off-campus in Bartow and intentionally omitted.
Outer bounds are rounded outward to the 0.25 m grid; geographic feature coordinates are unchanged.

Path widths now use instructor map measurements M01-M03 where matched; other walks use the reported 3 m minimum. M04 is an overall corridor including non-pavement and is never applied as a drivable width.
Robot navigation excludes motor/asphalt road rectangles as well as grass, water and buildings. Only mapped pedestrian features are permitted; this is not a traffic-rule or crossing-permission model.

width_policy.minimum_source: Instructor reports the smallest walking paths are about 3 m
width_policy.quality: Google Maps distance readouts supplied by instructor; approximate map measurements, not surveyed dimensions
width_policy.corridor_rule: Keep carriageways separate. Overall corridor widths that include medians/verges do not define traversable pavement.
width_policy.navigation_access: Pedestrian paths and separate sidewalks only; motor/asphalt carriageways are excluded even where a pedestrian feature crosses them.
